MLB_20260918.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Hao-Yu Lee and Riley Greene each hit a two-run homer in a five-run eighth inning as the Detroit Tigers rallied from six down to beat the Chicago White Sox 11-8 on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: White Sox blow 6-run lead and fall out of 1st place in AL Central with 11-8 loss to Tigers

MLB_20260918.name: Minnesota Twins at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — Connor Prielipp allowed two hits in a season-high seven innings and fellow rookie Walker Jenkins homered to lead the Minnesota Twins to a 3-0 victory over the Los Angeles Angels on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Connor Prielipp and Walker Jenkins lead Twins to 3-0 victory over Angels

MLB_20260918.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts homered twice and the Los Angeles Dodgers went deep four times in the eighth inning of an 8-2 victory over the San Francisco Giants on Friday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Mookie Betts homers twice and Dodgers go back-to-back twice in 8th inning of 8-2 win over Giants

MLB_20260919.name: Detroit Tigers at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Sean Burke pitched six effective innings, Miguel Vargas homered and the Chicago White Sox topped the Detroit Tigers 3-1 on Saturday for a sorely needed victory.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sean Burke and Miguel Vargas help the White Sox beat the Tigers 3-1

MLB_20260919.name: San Francisco Giants at Los Angeles Dodgers

headlines.description: — Mookie Betts went 4 for 4 with three doubles, Will Smith added three hits including a home run, and the Los Angeles Dodgers beat the San Francisco Giants 10-4 on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dodgers outslug Giants 10-4, led by Mookie Betts with four hits

headlines.description: — Christian Moore hit an infield single with two outs and the bases loaded that bounded off reliever Taylor Rogers' leg to score Zach Neto and give the Los Angeles Angels a 6-5, 11-inning victory over the Minnesota Twins on Saturday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Angels beat Twins 6-5 in 11 innings on Moore's bases-loaded, 2-out infield single

NFL_20260921.name: New York Giants at Los Angeles Rams

headlines.description: — The Los Angeles Rams' dismal season opener in Australia and their proliferating injury woes were nothing Davante Adams and Matthew Stafford couldn't overcome back home with a vintage performance against the Giants.
headlines.shortLinkText: Davante Adams, Matthew Stafford lead Rams past Giants 28-6 after Jaxson Dart's injury
